messages:
Maya SRE: Postmortem follow-up — we've seen recurring p95 latency spikes for text-gen in us-west (3 incidents in 6 days). Need concrete owners, short timelines, and an SLO/SLA emergency adjustment plan so customer-facing pages don't flake. Quick notes below.

Dan Smith: I dug into traces — kvcache evictions line up with the spikes, and large batched requests correlate with the worst tail. I can own dashboard panels + alert tuning.

Rachel P: +1. Also worried about error-budget burn. If we keep hitting p95 we should pause risky rollouts. Can we propose a short SLO relax/override? :thinking_face:

Kyle: Proposal (short-term): bump p95 target from 200ms -> 250ms for a rolling 24h emergency override, coupled with: 1) auto-rollback threshold at 5% extra error-budget burn, 2) add per-pool p95 and request-size distribution panels.

Priya Anand: I'll own kvcache retention/eviction tuning (ETA Tue EOD). @Dan Smith can you add the per-pool panels by Monday noon? @Maya SRE can you draft the emergency SLO change note we can push to ops?

Dan Smith: Yep — creating panels now. Grafana query I'll add for p95 by pool: ```histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="text-gen"}[5m])) by (le, pool))``` Will link once up.

ops-bot: ticket created: RED-7812 "us-west text-gen p95 spikes - kvcache tuning + dashboard + SLO override". Canaries scheduled on next deploy.

Maya SRE: Drafted emergency SLO override in the runbook and pushed a PR for the rollout policy gating: ```rollout_policy:
  emergency_slo_override:
    delta_ms: 50
    window: 24h
    auto_rollback_on_budget_burn_pct: 5
``` Adding a short blurb for customer comms. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/rollouts/pull/1289

Rachel P: Thanks. Can we also add an alert that fires when p95 deviation > 30ms sustained for 15m with response playbook pointer? We tend to miss regressions during off hours.

Maya SRE: Done — added a runbook pointer and ops-run alert. Alert severity: P2, page to oncall if sustained >30m.

Priya Anand: Plan summary: Priya -> kvcache tuning (Tue EOD), Dan -> dashboards + alert tweak (Mon noon), Maya -> SLO override PR + canary gating (today 6pm), Rachel -> customer comm blurb + QA for alerts (Wed morning). Reconvene Wed 10am to review telemetry and decide permanent SLO changes.

Dan Smith: :thumbsup: I'll post links to the new panels and the alert rule in this thread once live.

Maya SRE: Thanks everyone. If telemetry still shows recurrence after tuning we'll escalate to a throughput-cap change and quota-by-pool patch.

Priya Anand: Noted. Adding a short checklist in RED-7812 and assigning owners.

Rachel P: Appreciate the fast turnaround. We'll track error-budget usage closely during the override window.

Maya SRE: Closing action-items summary attached to ticket RED-7812. See you at the Wed check-in. :calendar:
